title: Supercritical mean--field limit for magnetized Hamiltonian dynamic
summary: The magnetized Vlasov--Poisson equation is a fundamental kinetic model for collisionless plasmas. We establish its quasi-neutral limit in two dimensions in the presence of a spatially inhomogeneous and time-dependent external magnetic field. In the same setting, we also establish the combined mean-field and quasi-neutral limit of the associated repulsive Coulomb particle system, thereby extending the results of \cite{han2021newton}.
